title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Mapishi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the sentence around a cooking word and explains it in Kiswahili, then uses it in a sentence.

floor.prerequisite: Explains a word from the passage.
floor.question: "Sebule" ni nini?

representations: the passage with cooking words in bold

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child explains "kukaanga" and writes a sentence with it.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "kuchemka kwa maji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maana ya neno hutokana na sentensi lilimo, si na jinsi linavyofanana na neno lingine.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "kuchuma majani ya chai" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Rudi kwenye sentensi lenyewe lenye neno hilo. Maana inatoka hapo, si kutoka sentensi ya karibu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika kifungu, "kuchemsha" maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "kupoza maji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha neno si maana yake. Soma tena sentensi.
Eleza maana kwa Kiswahili: kukaanga ni kupika kwa mafuta.

checks.question: Tumia "kiungo" (cha chakula) katika sentensi.
checks.answer: Mama aliweka kiungo cha tangawizi katika chai.

skills.key_step: The child answers who, where and what from the passage only, orders the events and gives the message of the whole story.
steps: Order the events and say the message.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders three events and writes the message.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nani alimsaidia Wanjiru?" Kwa nini "mwalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Rudi kwenye kifungu uone ni nani hasa alifanya kitendo hicho.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Walipika chakula gani?" Kwa nini "ugali" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu liko katika kifungu. Tumia kilichoandikwa, si kile unachokijua kutoka nyumbani.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ujumbe mkuu wa hadithi ni upi?" Kwa nini "Wanjiru alikuwa na sufuria nyekundu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe mkuu ni funzo la hadithi nzima, si jambo moja dogo ndani yake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Panga matukio kwa mpangilio." Kwa nini "D, A, C, B" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Matukio hupangwa kwa jinsi yalivyotokea katika hadithi. Soma tena kila tukio.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wanjiru alichemsha maji katika nini?" Kwa nini "kikombe" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kifungu kinataja vitu vingi. Rudi kwenye sentensi sahihi ujue jibu linalolingana na swali.
